items.title: Boston opened an RFP to operate and modernize its coordinated street-furniture program
items.business: City of Boston Property Management Department
items.description: The City of Boston is requesting proposals for a contractor to manage, maintain, expand and modernize its advertising-supported Coordinated Street Furniture Program. The scope includes bus shelters, public toilets, information panels, digital displays, benches and related public-realm amenities. Proposals are due November 4, 2026 at 12:00 p.m. Boston time.
why: Multi-asset program combines physical infrastructure, digital information and ongoing operations

items.title: Cambridge Retirement Board is seeking actuarial services for its $2.1 billion retirement system
items.description: The Cambridge Retirement Board published an RFP for qualified actuarial firms to perform full actuarial valuations, assess whether assets and contributions are sufficient to provide prescribed benefits, and recommend an appropriate funding schedule. The system reports about $2.1 billion in assets and 5,769 participants. Proposals are due October 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. EDT.

items.title: Massachusetts utilities extended the 1,000 MW energy-storage RFP to October 8
items.business: Eversource, National Grid and Unitil with Massachusetts DOER
items.description: Massachusetts electric distribution companies, coordinated with the Department of Energy Resources, are running Section 83E Round II for long-term contracts covering approximately 1,000 MW of mid-duration energy storage, including a 250-300 MW distribution-connected target. The official timeline was revised so proposals are now due October 8, 2026 at noon EDT; ShareFile URL requests are due October 2.
why: Official competitive RFP for approximately 1,000 MW
Deadline was materially extended to October 8
Includes a dedicated 250-300 MW distribution-connected procurement target
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Clean Energy / DOER and Distribution Companies

items.title: Hopkinton is seeking a vendor for a mental-health awareness and stigma-reduction media campaign
items.business: Town of Hopkinton Youth & Family Services
items.description: Hopkinton Youth & Family Services issued an open solicitation for a multimodal Mental Health Awareness Training public-awareness and stigma-reduction campaign. Public solicitation details call for campaign strategy and branding, messaging, digital and social assets, web graphics, print collateral, and editable source files/templates. Responses are due September 14, 2026.
why: Defined digital, social, web and print communications scope
items.sourceName: Town of Hopkinton / COMMBUYS listing via HigherGov

items.title: UMass opened an enterprise master-data-management platform and implementation RFP
items.description: The University of Massachusetts issued RFP UMass-2027-1124 for a SaaS Master Data Management platform and implementation services to modernize enterprise identity mastering across the university system. Public bid documents describe identity reconciliation, identifier management, affiliation lifecycle management, integrations, governance and future master-data expansion. Proposals are due September 23, 2026.
why: Enterprise multi-campus software and implementation scope
items.sourceName: University of Massachusetts public bid listing / PublicBidSearch

items.title: Westfield Retirement Board opened a legal-services RFP
items.description: The Westfield Contributory Retirement Board is seeking qualified individuals or firms to provide legal services consistent with Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 32 and PERAC regulations. The RFP was published September 10 and responses are due October 9, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. EST.

items.title: Lexington is seeking a vendor for a multilingual emergency-preparedness toolkit and community outreach
items.description: Lexington lists RFP 27-30 as open for an Emergency Preparedness Toolkit and Community Connections project. Public solicitation details describe resident-facing preparedness materials, supporting web content, multilingual translation, community engagement, graphic-design coordination and an outreach plan. Proposals are due September 24, 2026 at 12:00 p.m.
why: Official Town bid page lists the RFP as open

items.title: MCCA is bidding a new café and bar concession buildout at the Boston convention center
items.description: MCCA solicitation BD-27-1208-MCCA1-MCCA1-132584 covers construction of a new café/bar concession space at the Menino Convention & Exhibition Center. The scope includes demolition, electrical, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing, tile, flooring, kitchen equipment, millwork, signage, painting and finish restoration. Bids are due October 7, 2026.

items.title: Boston is seeking a vendor to develop a water-utilities registered apprenticeship program
items.business: City of Boston Office of Workforce Development
items.description: The City of Boston Office of Workforce Development is requesting proposals from a qualified vendor to support development of a comprehensive Registered Apprenticeship Program for high-demand technical positions involving heavy equipment and utility infrastructure. Proposals are due September 25, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Boston time.
why: Defined workforce-development scope for utility and heavy-equipment occupations

items.title: Foxborough, Plainville and Wrentham are seeking a three-year marketing and tourism consultant
items.business: Towns of Foxborough, Plainville and Wrentham
items.description: The Town of Foxborough, in partnership with Plainville and Wrentham, has an active RFP for experienced firms to provide marketing, media-relations and tourism consulting services under a three-year contract. Proposals are due September 17, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. The Town requires interested parties to register to access the procurement documents.
why: Official municipal procurement page lists the RFP as active

items.title: Boston Public Works is bidding as-needed bridge snow removal and salting services
items.business: City of Boston Public Works Department
items.description: Boston Public Works issued IFB EV00017898 for bridge snow removal and salting services on an as-needed basis. The City states that bids must be submitted through its Supplier Portal before September 24, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Boston time and that general bids require a 5% bid bond.

items.title: Worcester Public Schools is bidding a three-year web-filter SaaS contract
items.business: City of Worcester / Worcester Public Schools
items.description: The City of Worcester lists bid CR-8815-W7 for a three-year SaaS web-filter solution for Worcester Public Schools. The bid is categorized as Information Technology and closes October 7, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. The City's scope specifically identifies a Lightspeed web-filter solution, so this opportunity is most relevant to the publisher or qualified channel partners.
why: Official City of Worcester open bid

items.title: Westfield State opened an RFP for advancement data modeling ahead of a fundraising campaign
items.description: Westfield State University's official open-bids page lists RFP 2027-002 for Advancement Data Modeling, with responses due September 25, 2026 through its electronic procurement platform. Public solicitation information describes the work as data-modeling services for Institutional Advancement ahead of a comprehensive fundraising campaign.
why: Official university bid page lists RFP 2027-002

items.title: Mount Wachusett Community College is procuring cloud accommodation-management software
items.description: Mount Wachusett Community College's official procurement page lists Accommodation Management Software RFP 27-01 as an open bid. Public RFP details describe a secure cloud platform integrated with Banner for accessibility requests, documentation, approvals and accommodation letters, plus implementation, data migration, training and support. Secondary listings report a September 23 deadline; vendors should verify the exact closing time in the College's bid package.
why: Official college procurement page lists RFP 27-01 as open
Defined software, integration and implementation scope

items.title: Boston Public Health Commission is building a qualified consultant vendor pool across four service tracks
items.description: BPHC issued a single RFP to establish a pool of qualified consultants across Communications; Research, Evaluation and Assessment; Strategy and Planning; and Grant Writing. Qualified consultants may be engaged by BPHC programs and bureaus as project needs arise. Responses are due September 30, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
why: Explicit RFP to establish a qualified consultant pool
items.sourceName: Boston Public Health Commission / City of Boston

items.title: Boston Region MPO is procuring AV design and installation for conference rooms and offices
items.business: Boston Region Metropolitan Planning Organization / Metropolitan Area Planning Council
items.description: The Metropolitan Area Planning Council, acting for the Boston Region MPO, issued COMMBUYS opportunity BD-27-1217-MAP05-MAP05-132666 for audiovisual assessment, design, installation, configuration, testing and support across conference rooms, offices and a meeting area. Responses are due September 30, 2026.
why: Multi-room AV design and installation scope
items.sourceName: Boston Region MPO / MAPC COMMBUYS listing via Govly

items.title: Gloucester opened an RFP for destination marketing organization services
items.description: The City of Gloucester is soliciting proposals under RFP #27025 for a Destination Marketing Organization. The City's official bid page lists the solicitation as open and states that proposals must be submitted electronically through BidNet Direct by September 15, 2026 at 11:00 a.m.

items.title: Worcester is bidding $1.4 million of Complete Streets improvements at multiple locations
items.business: City of Worcester Department of Transportation & Mobility
items.description: City of Worcester bid 8809-W7 covers Complete Streets construction improvements across multiple intersections and addresses. The City lists an estimated cost of $1.4 million and a September 30, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. close. Published scope is for horizontal construction per City plans and specifications.
why: Official City of Worcester open construction bid

items.title: Community Teamwork is qualifying HEARTWAP heating, plumbing and asbestos contractors
items.description: Community Teamwork's RFP 26-28 seeks qualified contractors for heating-system repair and replacement, service calls, retrofits, related plumbing and asbestos-abatement services. The organization intends to establish an authorized-contractor list from which individual jobs may be awarded based on price quotes. Responses are due September 14 at 3:00 p.m. EST.
why: Selected contractors may receive individual jobs from an authorized-vendor pool

items.title: Making Opportunity Count is seeking heating, asbestos and chimney contractors for HWAP work
items.description: A published legal notice states that Making Opportunity Count is seeking qualified contractors for heating-system service and installation, asbestos abatement and chimney services funded through its annual HWAP grant. Completed proposals are due September 18, 2026. Vendors should obtain the issuer's RFP packet for full requirements.
why: Public RFP notice with a September 18 deadline
Defined heating, asbestos and chimney work
Notice states an effort to utilize small, minority-owned, women-owned and labor-surplus-area firms
items.sourceName: Public Legal Notice / Making Opportunity Count, Inc.

items.title: Everett Retirement Board is seeking outside legal services
items.description: The Everett Retirement Board is seeking proposals from qualified individuals or firms to provide legal services consistent with Massachusetts public-retirement law and PERAC regulations. The RFP became available September 1 and responses are due October 15, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. EST.

items.title: Amazon is seeking site-plan approval to launch Prime Air drone delivery from its Westborough facility
items.description: Westborough's Planning Board has scheduled a September 15 public hearing on application 26-02275, which requests a modification to an existing site-plan approval so Amazon can launch Prime Air drone delivery from its SMA1 facility at 64 Otis Street. This is an active permitting and digital-logistics project signal, not a vendor solicitation.
why: Specific public site-plan modification is under review
Project would launch Amazon Prime Air operations in Westborough
September 15 Planning Board hearing creates a concrete near-term milestone

items.title: Dinosaur Capital secured a $45.8 million construction loan for a 130-unit Lexington development
items.description: Affinius Capital and Axonic Capital announced a $45.8 million construction loan for Dinosaur Capital Partners' ground-up five-story development at 7 Hartwell Avenue. Plans call for 130 apartments, about 400 square feet of retail and resident amenities. The financing provides capital for the project's next phase; no open subcontract or vendor package was identified.
why: 130 units plus retail and amenities create multiple construction workstreams

items.title: HYM's proposed 215-unit senior-living project on Regis College land is in active Weston zoning review
items.business: HYM Investment Group LLC / Regis College
items.description: Weston's Planning Board scheduled a September 11 site inspection for HYM Investment Group's proposed rezoning of a 28.25-acre Regis College parcel at 300 Wellesley Street. Public reporting describes a planned 215-unit senior-living community with independent-living cottages and apartments, assisted-living units and memory-care units. The project still requires zoning and special-permit approvals, so this is an early development signal rather than confirmed procurement.
why: Official Weston Planning Board site inspection is occurring September 11
Large 28.25-acre site creates a significant future construction pipeline if approvals advance
items.sourceName: Town of Weston Planning Board / Weston Observer

items.title: Bottega Cannuccia is in early construction for a new Dorchester bakery-café and wine bar
items.description: Chef-owner Stefano Quaresima is preparing Bottega Cannuccia in the former home.stead bakery and café space in Fields Corner. Reporting published September 10 says the approximately 30-seat bakery-café and wine bar is in early construction with demolition underway and is targeting a January 2027 debut. No vendor solicitation has been announced.
why: Demolition and early construction are already underway
New hospitality concept has a defined January 2027 target
